title: Quantum Algorithm for Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithms with Space-Efficient Point Addition
summary: The Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm Problem (ECDLP) is a fundamental problem in cryptography, and reducing the resource requirements of quantum algorithms for solving ECDLP is an important goal. In this work, we present a space-efficient quantum algorithm for solving the ECDLP over prime fields, achieving an implementation with only $3n+6\lfloor \log_2 n \rfloor+O(1)$ logical qubits and $1056n^3/\log_2 n+O(n^2)$ Toffoli gates, where $n$ is the bit-length of the prime.
